archetype: Custom: 1930s Vintage Casino (Organic & Earthy base with Luxury Antique accents)

design_vision.core_loop: Study (Pomodoro) -> Earn Coins -> Gamble on Slots -> Unlock Rewards -> Repeat.
design_vision.visual_style: Hand-drawn, vintage, cartoon-like, rubber hose animation, sepia and brass textures, heavy ink outlines. NOT childish, NOT minimal, NOT flat design.

rules: No pure black or pure white. Use ink_outline_black for borders and outlines to simulate hand-drawn ink.
Never use default blue or modern vibrant colors.
Ensure all text has APCA accessible contrast against sepia backgrounds.

numbers.usage: Pomodoro timer countdown, Coin balance, Streak counter.

typography.instruction: Use expo-font to load these Google Fonts. Apply letter-spacing (tracking) to headings for vintage feel.

buttons.style: Hand-painted aesthetic, curved borders (borderRadius: 20), thick 3px solid ink_outline_black border.
buttons.background: vintage_red or antique_gold depending on hierarchy.
buttons.shadow: Hard black shadow offset (e.g., shadowColor: '#2C1E16', shadowOffset: {width: 4, height: 4}, shadowOpacity: 1, shadowRadius: 0, elevation: 5) to mimic old cartoon pop-ups.
buttons.feedback: Use TouchableOpacity or Pressable with scale down animation (squash) on press.

cards_and_modals.style: Should look like old paper tickets or vintage framed boxes. Add inner borders if possible to simulate printing frames.

menus.style: Avoid flat rectangles. Use SVG backgrounds or rounded containers to create curved, arched menu shapes reminiscent of old jukeboxes or slot machines.

icons.style: Antique brass or black ink outlines. No sleek modern line-icons. Use custom images where possible or thick bold vectors.

textures_and_patterns.background: Use the provided worn_paper_texture image as a repeating or stretched ImageBackground for the main app container.
textures_and_patterns.svg_patterns: Use SVG to create sunburst rays (vintage red and muted yellow alternating) for jackpot backgrounds. Use dense crosshatching for shadows.
textures_and_patterns.gradients: Radial gradients (lighter cream in center, darker sepia at edges) to create a vignette dusty casino atmosphere.

animations.style: Rubber hose animation: squash and stretch, bouncy, exaggerated.
animations.transitions: Vintage transition cards (e.g., iris wipe or circle crop closing in).
animations.feedback: Exaggerated scale bouncing when a button is pressed. Coins should spin and scale up when earned.
animations.tools: Use React Native Reanimated or Lottie for complex character/casino reactions.

worn_paper_texture.description: Base background for all screens. Set as ImageBackground with 'cover' resize mode.

vintage_slot_machine.description: Central UI element for the Casino screen. Place interactive reels over this background.

antique_brass_coin.description: Use as the currency icon across the app (Home balance, Reward costs).

vintage_roulette_wheel.description: Use for the 'Topic Roulette' screen to pick study topics.

locked_reward_ticket.description: Use in the Rewards screen to denote locked dopamine rewards.

screens.Home: Display coin balance prominently with 'antique_brass_coin'. Show streak counter. 'Start Study' button must be massive, bouncy, and in vintage_red. Active rewards shown on old paper ticket cards.
screens.Study_Screen: Vintage Pomodoro timer. Large 'Bungee' font for countdown. Flashing red 'CASINO CLOSED' UI on failure. Streak meter looks like a steam pressure gauge.
screens.Casino_Screen: Use 'vintage_slot_machine' asset. Implement physical-feeling spin lever. Jackpot animations feature radiating SVG sunbursts and coin showers.
screens.Topic_Roulette: Use 'vintage_roulette_wheel' asset. Center it and apply rotation animations. Topics written in 'Limelight' font around the wheel.
screens.Rewards_Screen: Inventory of old paper cards. Use 'locked_reward_ticket' for items on cooldown. Unlocked rewards have glowing antique_gold borders.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include both 'testID' (for React Native) and 'data-testid' (for web fallbacks) attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use generic flat React Native styles. Everything must look like 1930s hand-drawn animation with heavy #2C1E16 ink outlines.
Use hard shadows (shadowOffset with shadowOpacity: 1 and shadowRadius: 0) to mimic 2D cartoon depth, not soft modern blur.
Implement language in Spanish (Español) natively across all hardcoded strings. Do not use English.
Build strictly in standard .js files as per user configuration, using Expo and React Native primitives.
Wrap the main screens in ImageBackground using 'worn_paper_texture' rather than plain solid background colors.
For icons, avoid modern line-art vector icons. Fall back to text emojis or text if custom images aren't sufficient, but heavily prioritize the provided media assets.
Use AsyncStorage for the local-only, offline-first data model (coins, streaks, rewards inventory).
